The frame syllabi come from Ohio University's new public Concourse syllabus search (launched Aug 2026 under Ohio Revised Code 3345.029), which shows only a few state-required syllabus elements, so these four 'public-no-ai' results mean the public page is silent, not that the course has no AI rule.
